sentences.text: Christina Applegate -LRB- born November 25 , 1971 -RRB- is an American actress and dancer who as an adolescent actress started playing the role of Kelly Bundy on the Fox sitcom Married ... with Children -LRB- 1987 -- 97 -RRB- .	Kelly Bundy	Kelly Bundy	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company
